faqs.q: How long does a branding project take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope. A full visual identity (logo plus brand manual) takes 2 to 4 weeks. With extra materials it can run to 6 or 8 weeks.

faqs.q: What do I need to get started?
faqs.a: Just a discovery call. You tell us about your company, your audience and your goals, and we prepare the creative brief. You don't need to bring anything prepared.

faqs.q: Do you hand over editable files?
faqs.a: Always. We deliver everything in editable formats: AI, EPS and SVG for the logo; Figma for product design; PDF and InDesign for print materials.

faqs.q: Do you redesign existing brands?
faqs.a: Yes. We analyse your current brand and identify what to keep, what to evolve and what to change completely.

faqs.q: How many rounds of revisions are included?
faqs.a: Up to 3 rounds at each stage of the project. If you need changes beyond that scope, we quote them separately and transparently.

detalle.titulo: Alyer: a brand that reads from thirty meters away, in motion.
detalle.reto: A heavy-haulage brand is read from thirty metres away, side on and moving. And it had to sign two businesses —the fleet and the workshop that builds the units— without splitting into two logos.
detalle.hicimos: A symbol built on Alyer’s «A» that reads as both movement and machined part, inside a short system: black, red, four greys and two typefaces. Both lines share symbol and colour, only the descriptor changes, and a 35-page manual fixes it all.

stack.tambien: Everything is handed over editable and in your name.

faqs.q: Can I edit the website myself?
faqs.a: Yes. You get a dashboard to change text, images, products and prices without touching code, and we show you how to use it.

faqs.q: Which payments and shipping options can be integrated?
faqs.a: Mercado Pago, Culqi and PayPal for payments, and shipping with rates by zone or quoted by the buyer's address. If you use another provider, we integrate it.

faqs.q: Does the store issue receipts and invoices?
faqs.a: Yes. Every sale issues the electronic receipt or invoice and sends it to SUNAT, without copying orders into another system.

faqs.q: Do you build iOS and Android apps at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes, from a single codebase for both platforms, connected to the same system as your website. We also publish them in the stores.

faqs.q: Are the domain and hosting included?

faqs.q: How long does a project take to build?
faqs.a: It depends on scope. A working MVP can be ready in 6 to 10 weeks. More complex platforms take 3 to 6 months. We always start with an architecture sprint.

faqs.q: Can you integrate with existing systems?
faqs.a: Yes, it's one of our specialities. We integrate with ERPs, CRMs, legacy databases, third-party APIs and any system with a documented interface.

faqs.q: What happens after launch?
faqs.a: We offer maintenance and ongoing support: monitoring, bug fixing, dependency updates and new features on a regular cycle.

faqs.q: Do we get the source code?
faqs.a: Always. The code is 100% yours from the start. We work in your repository from day one, with the full history and technical decisions documented.

faqs.q: Can you work alongside our in-house team?
faqs.a: Yes, and we enjoy it. We can act as an extended team, adding capacity and experience while collaborating with your developers.

puente.titulo: Does your data come from machines or sensors?
puente.texto: With IoT we connect equipment and devices so AI can work with real-time data.

faqs.q: How long does an AI system take to implement?
faqs.a: A working prototype can be ready in 2 to 4 weeks. A production system with full integrations takes 6 to 12 weeks. We start with the highest-impact use case.

faqs.q: Do I need my own data to start?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Many projects use base models with no proprietary training data. If you do have data, we use it to tailor the system and improve accuracy.

faqs.q: Which AI models do you use?
faqs.a: Whichever fits the case: commercial models for complex reasoning, open models when privacy comes first, and specialised models for specific tasks.

faqs.q: Is my company's data safe?
faqs.a: Yes. We can deploy the system entirely on your infrastructure or in private clouds. We never share your data with third parties, and the contract says so.

faqs.q: Can it integrate with our current systems?
faqs.a: Yes, that's our speciality. We integrate with anything that has an API: CRMs, ERPs, databases, email and in-house systems.

stack.tambien: We pick the model per task, by quality, speed and cost, and switch when a better one comes out.

iot.titulo: Your equipment, connected to your system.
iot.bajada: Real-time monitoring, alerts and dashboards for your plant, fleet or warehouse, with the platform, cloud and integrations that make it work.

hacemos.texto: Temperature, vibration, consumption or status of every machine, with its full history, on the dashboard and on your phone.
Rules by threshold, by trend or by a device going silent, with escalating notices and a record of who handled each alert.
PLCs, meters and industrial sensors over Modbus or OPC UA, with an on-site gateway that keeps the data if the network drops.
Data over encrypted MQTT, stored in a time-series database, with per-plant permissions and an API for your other systems.
Cellular GPS for vehicles, and BLE or LoRaWAN tags for tools and containers inside the plant.
With the history of vibration, temperature and running hours, wear shows up before the machine stops.

puente.titulo: With your equipment's data, AI does the rest.
puente.texto: With each machine's history we build predictions, smart alerts and automatic reports.

faqs.q: Do you work with the equipment I already have?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as they output data somehow: Modbus, OPC UA, a digital output or an API. If not, we propose the right sensor.

faqs.q: Do I need internet at the plant?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. The gateway stores the data and sends it when the signal returns, and where Wi-Fi does not reach we use cellular or LoRaWAN.

faqs.q: Where is the data stored?
faqs.a: In the cloud of your choice or on your own servers. The data is yours and can be exported whenever you want.

faqs.q: Where should we start?
faqs.a: With a small pilot: a few devices and a single metric that matters. If the data is useful, we scale.

faqs.q: Does it integrate with my ERP or other systems?
faqs.a: Yes. Equipment data can reach your ERP, CRM or reports through an API.

faqs.q: Is it safe to connect the plant to the internet?
faqs.a: Every device identifies itself with its own certificate, everything travels encrypted and the plant network is never exposed: the gateway only connects out to the platform.

faqs.q: Can you migrate my website without downtime?
faqs.a: Yes. We copy everything, check that it works the same on the new server and only then switch the domain, taking care of email too.

faqs.q: What happens if my website goes down?
faqs.a: Monitoring alerts us right away and we act as agreed in your support plan.

faqs.q: How often are backups made?
faqs.a: We set it according to how often your data changes; daily is typical, and we test that they can be restored.

faqs.q: Do you support systems you didn't build?
faqs.a: Yes. We first review the code and infrastructure, and tell you clearly what can be kept and what should change.

faqs.q: How is support billed?
faqs.a: With monthly maintenance and support plans, based on the size of the system and the response time you need.
